capabilities: track focus time per note and PDF reading time
display focus time in the status bar
show analytics dashboard with day/month/year/total views
rank top 10 notes by focus time
extras: The author accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to measure how much time you spend reading or working on each note.
summary: Time-tracking plugin that records focus time per note and shows analytics dashboards with charts and a top-notes leaderboard.
